I told Dana that Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats. I replied in a thread on her message in our direct messages.

- **Source:** in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, Dana posted 180 seats for the amendment. A few minutes later she corrected it: "It's 185, not 180."
- **Not checked against the contract:** I couldn't see the amendment itself, since no Quarrendon contract files are available to her. I suggested she confirm the number against the signed copy she sent to June Osei-Lark before the QBR.
- **gbrain didn't work:** my search was refused because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it returned nothing. Someone with admin access to the gbrain host needs to bind the token to the right person or people. Until then I can only answer from the world tools.
